name: flora-rewarder-27b
description: Flora terminal reward: whole episode, up to 64 frames at <=10 FPS, 1-5 score decoded greedily under a regex; progress=(E[score]-1)/4 from P(1..5) at the score token.

name: flora-rewarder-27b-prefix
description: RewardBox prefix-curve extension of the Flora terminal reward: each causal prefix is scored as a whole episode with the native sampling, timing and prompt.

name: gvl
description: Robometer's API-based Gemini progress baseline. Strictly reuses the 8-frame sub-protocol expressible by its confusion-matrix GVL command (Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite); upstream released no reward-alignment/policy-ranking recipe, so Table I equivalence is not claimed.

name: gvl-gemini-3.5-flash-lite
description: Robometer GVL's official JPEG/shuffle/prompt/SSE/parser path, explicitly migrated to Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite. Google refuses the frozen 2.5 endpoint for new users; this identity does not pose as the upstream confusion-matrix recipe or a Table I reproduction.

name: gvl-gemini-3.8-flash
description: GVL + Gemini 3.8 Flash in Gemini native format; keeps the existing 8-frame scoring flow and records the model/transport migration separately; no paper reproduction is claimed.

name: gvl-gemini-3.8-flash-dense
description: GVL + Gemini 3.8 Flash; reuses the runner's sampling grid, aligned with SOLE 1 Hz by default. Keeps GVL's global random shuffle and the same prompt/parser; one request covers all sampled frames.

name: jev-1.14-pair
environment: shared; base_url and JEV_API_KEY or api_key_env
upstream_entry: rewardbox.adapters.jev (RewardBox protocol over the jev-1.14.0 API)
description: Jev 1.14, Pair protocol: one request per adjacent pair of sampled observations, two-option choice (rising / falling). progress is 0 for the first observation, then the judgement of each transition; it is not a curve (see raw.transition_directions).

name: jev-1.14-sequence
environment: shared; base_url and JEV_API_KEY or api_key_env
upstream_entry: rewardbox.adapters.jev (RewardBox protocol over the jev-1.14.0 API)
description: Jev 1.14, Sequence protocol: all sampled observations (1 FPS by default) in one request, one five-level completion question per observation; progress is the expected level x 25.

name: lrm-completion
environment: server in its own py3.10 env
description: LRM binary completion head: native per-frame 0/1 completion verdicts; inference through the official Flask server.

name: lrm-completion-vllm
description: lrm-completion: native prompt and frame/pair semantics; opt-in batched vLLM execution.

name: lrm-contrastive
environment: server in its own py3.10 env
description: LRM temporal contrastive head: 0 for the first frame, then adjacent-frame comparisons output -1/0/+1; inference through the official Flask server.

name: lrm-contrastive-vllm
description: lrm-contrastive: native prompt and frame/pair semantics; opt-in batched vLLM execution.

name: lrm-progress
environment: server in its own py3.10 env
description: LRM absolute progress head: native per-frame 0-1 progress; inference through the official Flask server.

name: lrm-progress-vllm
description: lrm-progress: native prompt and frame/pair semantics; opt-in batched vLLM execution.

name: lrm-tri
environment: server in its own py3.10 env
description: Fixed equal-weight fusion of the three LRM heads: contrastive is first mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1], then fused with progress/completion; no separate tri weights or tunable fusion coefficients.

name: primo-r1-7b
description: PRIMO-R1 native initial image/video/current image input; one terminal raw percentage. The task instruction is bound into its regression question.

name: primo-r1-7b-prefix
description: Explicit RewardBox prefix-curve extension of PRIMO-R1; each point uses the native interleaved input, prompt and sampling. No interpolation.

name: procvlm-2b
description: Released ProcVLM-2B procedure-grounded progress estimator. Returns the official textual completion percentage and preserves every raw reasoning/output record.

name: robo-valuerl-value
upstream_entry: Open-X-Humanoid/Robo-ValueRL@1618bcb; OpenPi_X_Humanoid_Critic.predict_value -> remain_time; official HL-Gauss decode and annotation interpolation
description: Released Robo-ValueRL short-history remaining-step estimator. Returns the paper-defined [0,1] progress value and preserves decoded remaining steps plus all key-frame distributions as raw evidence.

name: robodopamine-8b
description: Compatibility name: same as robodopamine-v2-8b. BEFORE/AFTER three-view relative progress scoring, averaged over three modes (forward/incremental/backward), as the official README recommends.

name: robodopamine-v1-3b
description: v1 / GRM-3B (RoboBrain2.0-3B). BEFORE/AFTER three-view relative progress scoring, averaged over three modes (forward/incremental/backward), as the official README recommends. The v1 official examples use three views and a reference goal image; quality without a goal image is unverified.

name: robodopamine-v1-8b
description: v1 / GRM-8B (RoboBrain2.0-8B). BEFORE/AFTER three-view relative progress scoring, averaged over three modes (forward/incremental/backward), as the official README recommends. The v1 official examples use three views and a reference goal image; quality without a goal image is unverified.

name: robodopamine-v2-4b
description: v2 / GRM-2.0-4B-Preview. BEFORE/AFTER three-view relative progress scoring, averaged over three modes (forward/incremental/backward), as the official README recommends.

name: robodopamine-v2-8b
description: v2 / GRM-2.0-8B-Preview. BEFORE/AFTER three-view relative progress scoring, averaged over three modes (forward/incremental/backward), as the official README recommends.

name: robometer-4b
description: Dedicated reward model with a progress head and a success head; one forward pass outputs per-frame progress and success probability for the whole trajectory; natively supports trajectory comparison.

name: robometer-4b-libero
description: Dedicated reward model with a progress head and a success head; one forward pass outputs per-frame progress and success probability for the whole trajectory; natively supports trajectory comparison.

name: roboreward-4b
description: Fine-tuned Qwen3-VL that outputs a discrete 1-5 terminal progress score, mapped to (s-1)/4. The model card defines an end-of-episode score; per-prefix calls are an extension.

name: roboreward-8b
description: Fine-tuned Qwen3-VL that outputs a discrete 1-5 terminal progress score, mapped to (s-1)/4. The model card defines an end-of-episode score; per-prefix calls are an extension.

name: rynnvalue-4b
description: RynnValue 4B temporal-distance value model.  Returns the official raw negative remaining-time curve through the isolated Robometer HTTP server.

name: rynnvalue-8b
description: RynnValue 8B temporal-distance value model.  Returns the official raw negative remaining-time curve through the isolated Robometer HTTP server.

name: sole-r1-8b
environment: server in its own py3.10 env
description: SOLE-R1 8B video-language reasoning reward model.  Calls the official standalone reward server and returns its raw per-timestep progress percentages plus reasoning traces; supports external-only or paired external/left-wrist views.

name: topreward
description: Robometer Table-I TOPReward baseline: official prefix log-probs are min-max normalised and linearly interpolated to every sampled input frame.

name: topreward-qwen2.5-7b
description: Unverified non-Table-I TOPReward native-client variant. The vendored QwenClient hard-codes Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration; validate this Qwen2.5 checkpoint independently before relying on it.

name: vlac-2b
description: Official pair-wise image critic; adjacent-frame critics are accumulated by the official formula into nominal 0-100 progress. RewardBox uses the in-memory image entry point and keeps the raw scale.

name: vlac-8b
description: Official pair-wise image critic; adjacent-frame critics are accumulated by the official formula into nominal 0-100 progress. RewardBox uses the in-memory image entry point and keeps the raw scale.

name: vlac-cut
description: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B video progress critic: a 2 Hz frame sequence -> generated, timestamped, signed progress keypoints (may regress, non-monotonic). The raw response and keypoints are kept.

name: vlac-cut-vllm
description: VLAC-Cut native Swift frame/prompt/curve protocol with opt-in vLLM generation.

name: vlm-pair
environment: shared; OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY or api_key_env
description: General VLM, Pair protocol: one request per adjacent pair of sampled observations, forced +1/-1 direction. progress is 0 for the first observation, then the judgement of each transition; it is not a curve (see raw.transition_directions).

name: vlm-sequence
environment: shared; OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY or api_key_env
description: General VLM, Sequence protocol: all sampled observations (1 FPS by default) in one request, one 0-100 completion score per observation. The API model is the required option model=...; prompts are RewardBox's own (v1).
